items.title: 2.10 Electronic configuration aur semiconductors ka banna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.10, printed pages 41-42.

blocks.text: Semiconductors woh materials hain jo kuch halaat mein bijli guzarte (conduct) hain; yeh bohat se electronic aalaat mein istemal hote hain, smartphones, laptops aur garion samet. Silicon, germanium aur arsenic woh anasir hain jo semiconductor ka kaam kar sakte hain, aur semiconductors in anasir ki munfarid electronic configuration ki wajah se banaye ja sakte hain. Silicon (Z = 14) ki configuration 2, 8, 4 hai, to us ke valence shell mein chaar electrons hain. Khalis crystalline shakal mein har silicon atom chaar doosre silicon atoms se bandha hai, aur is shakal mein crystal mein se electronic conduction ka koi imkan nahi.

blocks.alt: Khalis silicon ka crystal: nau Si atoms chakor tarteeb mein, har ek apne chaar parosiyon se covalent bonds se jura hai; har bond ek lens ki shakal hai jis mein do electrons hain, har atom se ek; kinaron se bhi bonds bahar ja rahe hain. Labels: Covalent bond, Silicon valence electrons, Silicon atoms.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.17: Khalis silicon ka crystal (kitab ki Figure 2.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: P-type aur N-type semiconductors khalis semiconductor mein milawat (impurity) ke atoms dal kar, doping se, bante hain. Boron ya aluminium jaisi trivalent impurities dalne se P-type semiconductor banta hai, jabke phosphorus ya arsenic jaisi pentavalent impurities dalne se N-type. Farq is mein hai ke impurity lattice mein holes, musbat charge carriers, banati hai (P-type) ya izafi electrons, manfi charge carriers (N-type).

blocks.prompt: Khalis silicon conduct kyun nahi karta, halanke us ke paas chaar valence electrons dastiyab hain?
blocks.explanation: Chaar valence electrons mein se har ek parosi silicon atom se bandhan mein band hai, to crystal mein charge le jane ke liye koi azad electrons ya holes nahi. Sirf doping, jo holes ya faltu electrons jorti hai, current ko behne deti hai.

items: Semiconductors (Si, Ge, As) kuch halaat mein conduct karte hain; khalis silicon (2, 8, 4) poori tarah bandha hai aur conduct nahi karta.
Trivalent atoms (B, Al) se doping holes wala p-type deti hai; pentavalent atoms (P, As) se izafi electrons wala n-type.
